d:
Karpoori Thakur became the chief minister of Bihar twice in 70s. Karpoori Thakur was known as the champion of backward classes as he introduced OBC reservation in Bihar that was first time in any indian state. He was freedom fighter, a socialist leader and staunch follower of Acharya Narendra Dev and Dr. Rammanohar Lohia. Lalu yadav and Nitish kumar have nurtured their political skills under the aegis of Karpoori thakur. Watch this latest episode of The Lallantop's special political series named Mukhyamantri by Editor Saurabh Dwivedi for more details.
